steps.title: Seed
steps.caption: The attacker compromises a software vendor and slips the payload into a signed-looking update. It lands on one finance PC. Defenders see: nothing obvious yet - only a normal-looking update download in proxy logs
steps.defender: EDR and Sysmon record the process, memory and image-load events. Correlate them with the parent process.

steps.title: Strike
steps.caption: Machines restart (in the real event, an update server forced reboots). The payload opens the raw disk with admin rights and overwrites the master boot record with its own stub and a ransom note. Defenders see: Sysmon Event ID 9 RawAccessRead targeting \\.\PhysicalDrive0 , seconds before each host goes down
